newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Switches in dollars, lire, stg.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Switches in dollars, lire, stg.

text.p: Bond analysts' latest Eurobond trade ideas spanned a range of currencies.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY Helaba is cheap against the swap and the BTP trading at 16 and 10 b.p. respectively. This switch offers around a 12 b.p. pick up in yield.
STRATEGY This move offers around a 19 b.p. pick-up in yield and is cheap against the swap at 3 b.p. through and the BTP at 11 b.p. through.
STRATEGY Along with around a 29 b.p. pick-up in yield Deutsche Bank is attractive against the swap and BTP at 8 and 16 b.p. through respectively.
SELL Asia Development Bank zero coupon 08/04
STRATEGY This switch offers a pick-up in yield of 6 b.p. beats the curve by 27 b.p. and shortens duration ny 3-1/2 years.
STRATEGY This move will beat the curve by 6 b.p. and offers a yield pick-up of 10 b.p. The spread is at a three-month high.
STRATEGY With a pick-up in yield of 13 b.p. the spread is at a two-month high.
